title: CSCI 344 — Programming Language Concepts
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Identify the core syntactic and semantic components of high-level programming languages as defined in the course catalog.
Explain how problem-solving methods like decomposition, abstraction, and correctness arguments apply across diverse language implementations.
Differentiate between language-specific details and general principles of programming language design using comparative analysis.
